scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock'].forEach((file)=>fs.rmSync(file,{force:true})); const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(!ua.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1);}"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flowdesk/api-client run build && pnpm --filter @flowdesk/frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @flowdesk/api-client run build && pnpm --filter @flowdesk/frontend run typecheck
